en: A colored illustrated postcard showing a panoramic view over a city along a winding river, seen from an elevated terrace with a stone balustrade. In the right foreground stands a bronze lion monument on a large stone pedestal. Several figures in early 20th‑century clothing look out over the cityscape and surrounding hills. At the top of the card there is German text identifying the scene.
